findings_qualitative.value: Gas fraction change from intermediate to high density at fixed z equals 2-3 Gyr of cosmic evolution

evidence.quote: at $z=0.73$ it takes a galaxy $2-3$ Gyrs to experience a decrease in the gas fraction by a factor of 1.8

claims.hypothesis: ISM mass depends on environment at z~0.73
claims.experiment: Stack ALMA Band 7 continuum in three density bins; convert to M_ISM
claims.result: M_ISM elevated at intermediate density (1.5x, ~2.5 sigma), lower at high density (0.7x)
claims.finding: ISM mass has a modest dependence on environment

evidence.quote: $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{ISM}}$ is found to have a small dependence on environment
relatively constant with density, $\tau = 210 \pm 71$ Myr

claims.hypothesis: Environmental processes drive gas loss at high density
claims.experiment: Compare gas fraction drop with evolution with redshift
claims.result: Drop by factor 1.8 equals 2-3 Gyr of evolution
claims.finding: Mergers and ram pressure stripping/strangulation likely play a role

evidence.quote: These results are suggestive and more observations of the ISM in intermediate and high density galaxies are needed to test these ideas.

why_this_method.value: Dust continuum avoids poorly constrained CO-to-H2 conversion and is cheaper than CO

evidence.quote: estimating the ISM mass from CO lines is expensive and uncertain due to the poorly constrained conversion from CO to H$_{2}$

limitations_admitted.value: Large stellar mass uncertainties reduce significance of f_gas trend; merger fraction differences not significant

evidence.quote: though the uncertainties in stellar mass decrease the significance of this trend
